Scatter Lab CEO Jongyoon Kim, SpoonLabs CEO Hyukjae Choi, and Hashed CEO Simon Kim discussed the shifting balance of power in the content industry in the AI era, moderated by Sung Ho-chul, Tokyo bureau chief of The Chosun Ilbo.
할리우드가 중심이 된 뒤 1950년대에 TV가 보급되자 이번엔 영화계가: After Hollywood became the center of the industry, television spread in the 1950s, and this time the film industry looked down on TV. They even campaigned against putting Hollywood content on television, but in just 10–20 years, their positions had reversed.
해리포터를 예로 들면, 원작에서는 말포이가 악역이고 해리포터가 주인공입니: Take Harry Potter, for example. In the original, Malfoy is a villain and Harry Potter is the protagonist. But if a user befriends Malfoy and plays by fighting against Harry Potter, the original author, J.K. Rowling, might feel uncomfortable. In that case, she would ban that kind of play.
행사 시작 전에도 성 지국장님이 AI 콘텐츠는 좀 어색하고 이상하지 않냐: Even before the event started, Bureau Chief Sung asked me whether AI content was a bit awkward and strange. The AI dramas that look that way are actually test videos we release to users around the world. They’re not content we made to generate revenue. So you shouldn’t look at those and conclude that AI video is low-quality. We put them out very cheaply and quickly to see whether viewers respond, and if they do, we move up the production tiers step by step.
회사 소개 감사합니다. 그럼 AI가 콘텐츠 산업을 어떻게 바꾸고 있다고: Thank you for introducing your company. Could you also say a little about how you see AI changing the content industry?
